notes.title: A Portal dating sim? Yep. Aperture Dating Simulator is set to release on August 28
notes.notes: Sometimes I think I've seen it all, and then along comes a Portal dating sim with Aperture Dating Simulator.Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/08/a-portal-dating-sim-yep-aperture-dating-simulator-is-set-to-release-on-august-28/

notes.title: Our release date has been announced!
notes.notes:
After some hard work and a lot of patience, Aperture Dating Simulator is officially ready to say... we will be releasing on AUGUST 28TH, 2025! (if everything goes well)



Of course, like any game, we can't guarantee this is 100% accurate, but at the pace we're going, we're well on our way to being done by then. Thank you so much for your support and your patience!
